messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads-up: Product wants to run an A/B pricing experiment for mid-market (new list price + two discount arms). Need quick agreement on grandfathering, invoice reconciliation, and how to reflect experiment IDs on invoices. @Carlos can you advise on ops constraints?

Priya (Product): Experiment: control = current list, variant A = +10% list, variant B = +20% list but with higher usage thresholds before stepping down. Target 5% of mid-market for 4 weeks. We want to tag invoices with experiment_id so we can join revenue -> cohort easily.

Carlos (Billing Ops): Important notes: most gateways don't accept arbitrary metadata on consolidated invoices; we can add invoice_memo or invoice_metadata but Chargebee/Stripe mapping differs. For internal recon, adding experiment_id to billing_export rows is easy. Changing invoice PDF content is heavier.

Ethan (Sales): Also need to confirm grandfathering for customers under active discounts or custom quotes. My ask: grandfather all existing active commitments for 120 days, unless a customer explicitly opts into the new plan. Sales to handle opt-ins.

Ruth (Legal): 120 days seems long but ok if we include opt-out. Need short email copy and contract amendment template. Suggest: "Customers on existing commitments may retain current pricing for 120 days following experiment assignment; opting into the experiment is available via account team." We'll need to flag SRs for opt-ins.

Nina (Finance): Quick decision points: 1) Experiment metadata on exported rows (yes) 2) Invoice PDF changes (no for canary) 3) Grandfathering length = 120d opt-out allowed 4) Mid-cycle account moves: prorate days for seat fees, bucket usage billed on actual usage monthly recon.

Carlos (Billing Ops): Agree with Nina. For mid-cycle moves, we can do a two-step: provisional invoice using assignment-days prorate, then final recon pass after month close that issues corrections if delta > $25. Otherwise auto-credit. Will draft runbook.

Priya (Product): Acceptance criteria for experiment: 1) net ARR delta within +/-2% for cohort 2) <1% spike in billing support tickets 3) instrumented attribution via experiment_id on export for QA.

payments-bot: Payment gateway status: Chargebee API v2 supports invoice.notes (free text) and invoice.custom_fields (limited). Mapping planned: invoice_notes -> not shown to customer by default; we will use exports for experiments.

Carlos (Billing Ops): Action items: I'll add experiment_id to billing_export schema today (column: experiment_id). Priya please provide the experiment id tag. I'll also confirm Chargebee behavior and post the recon draft.

Ethan (Sales): For customers with negotiated minimums, can we auto-exempt them from the experiment? I don't want account teams surprised.

Ruth (Legal): Exempt users: add rule in roll-out: "Do not assign accounts with executed amendments containing pricing schedules to experiment." We need a checklist for the rollout engineer.

Nina (Finance): Sounds like consensus. Quick poll: do we want 120d grandfathering or 90d? React with :one: for 120d, :two: for 90d.

Priya (Product): :two: (90d)

Ethan (Sales): :one: (120d)

Carlos (Billing Ops): :one: (120d) - ops prefers longer window to avoid churn in billing adjustments.

Ruth (Legal): :one: (120d)

Nina (Finance): Ok majority for 120d. Carlos please proceed with export change and runbook. Priya, send the experiment_id and the cohort list by EOB. I'll draft customer-facing wording for legal review.

Carlos (Billing Ops): Will do. Posting runbook draft in /docs and a sample CSV export in #eng-billing once done.

Priya (Product): Thanks all. We'll hold rollout until runbook + exports are confirmed.
